note: Treatment is the self-modifying colony. Control runs the same pipeline with self-modification off, on a state tree forked from main and then evolved on its own. Differences in the first runs are noise. A lasting lead needs many paired runs, and a gain that traces to a change the treatment arm chose itself. This is not a claim of general intelligence or a breakthrough.

fork.note: Fork point for the control arm. Control state is copied from treatment at the first control evolve, then frozen (self-heal knobs reset to defaults; the in-flight perturb_cooldown_cycles trial is not continued). After that, control evolves on its own tree. seeded_sha is filled at that first run.
fork.fork_note_hive: Forked after Hive merged (PR #8). Control disables Hive learning through colony/hive_adapter.py.

control.note: Not seeded yet. The first control evolve takes the snapshot.
